Product

Everything you need to earn reach on purpose.

Five instruments, one goal: your content in more of the right feeds.

AI comments

Comments that sound like you wrote them

Thoughtful comments are how you get noticed on LinkedIn — and the first thing busy people skip. Linkboost drafts replies in your voice, in any language, in one click.

  • Written from the post's actual content, not canned templates
  • Edit before posting, or send as-is
  • Unlimited generation on paid plans

Smart Feed

One feed with only the posts worth engaging

Stop scrolling noise. Follow the people who matter to your niche and see their newest posts in a single feed built for fast, genuine engagement.

  • Track any profile — pod member or not
  • New posts surface the moment they're published
  • Comment without leaving Linkboost

Discover & Engage

Get on the radar of the right people

AI finds trending posts in your niche so you can land a smart comment early — before the crowd shows up — and turn strangers into followers.

  • Trending posts surfaced by topic and audience
  • AI-drafted comments tuned to each post
  • Unlimited usage on paid plans

Analytics

Know exactly what's working

Every boost, every post, every wave of engagement — measured. See which topics earn reach and which flop, then write your next post with evidence.

  • Impressions, likes, and comments per post
  • Boost performance against your account average
  • Pod-level stats to spot your best communities

Engagement pods

Pods, minus the coordination

Join pods of creators in your niche. When you boost a post, members' likes and comments land automatically in the first hour — no group chats, no begging for engagement.

  • Join unlimited pods, or create your own
  • Blocklists, bans, and reporting keep pods clean
  • Custom audiences on paid plans

FAQ

Questions, answered.

A pod is a group of creators who agree to engage with each other's posts. Early likes and comments tell the LinkedIn algorithm a post is worth showing to more people, so members grow faster together than they would alone. Linkboost automates the whole exchange: when you boost a post, your pods' members like and comment on it automatically. No group chats, no chasing favors.

Yes. Linkboost runs server-side — there's no browser extension attached to your account — and every interaction is rate-limited and spaced out to match natural LinkedIn activity. Comments are varied so nothing looks templated. Thousands of accounts use Linkboost every day and stay in good standing.

Linkboost reads the post and drafts a comment that actually responds to it — no canned "Great post!" filler. Send it as-is, edit it first, or regenerate until it sounds like you. AI comments work across the product: on boosted posts, in your Smart Feed, and in Discover & Engage.

All of them, effectively. The AI writes comments in the language of the post it's responding to, and the pod marketplace filters by country and language — so your engagement comes from people who actually speak your audience's language.

Three boosted posts per month (one per day), one pod per boost, and the core product: join unlimited pods, create your own, comment templates, and LinkedIn analytics. No credit card required — upgrade only when you need more volume.

Yes. Cancel from your dashboard in a couple of clicks — no emails, no retention calls. You keep paid features until the end of your billing period, and the free plan keeps working after that.
